editorial.tldr: Reinforcement Learning is a loose grouping of arXiv papers on RL for LLMs and agents, plus one AWS guide, not one developing story. Since Oct 23 it has collected work on rollout cost, RAG calibration and agent harnesses, and two studies showing that fine-grained credit and multi-turn RL gains depend on the setup.
editorial.whats_new: Nov 10: AutoScaffold argues RLVR's outcome reward shrinks each attempt to a single number and proposes AI-guided training-time scaffolds; Nov 9's MaxIM applies RL to bounded-memory summarization of long interaction histories.
editorial.why_it_matters: Agent RL results are sensitive to rollout budget, numerical setup and reward granularity, so a reported gain may not transfer to your harness. All are paper-reported, not production evidence.
editorial.take_for_builders: Before adopting any of these recipes, rerun them at your own sampling breadth and turn limits, and A/B fine-grained credit or scaffolded rewards against episode-level reward; treat all results as unreplicated.
